title: Deep learning, computer-aided radiography reading for tuberculosis: a diagnostic accuracy study from a tertiary hospital in India
summary: Against microbiological confirmation, qXR reached AUC 0.81, 71% sensitivity and 80% specificity; radiologist sensitivity was 56% with 80% specificity. Retrospective case-control cohort of 317 confirmed cases and 612 controls at one tertiary hospital; specificity/sensitivity limits and need for prospective studies are stated by the authors.
ai_technology: The learned qXR computer-aided detection system classifies chest radiographs for tuberculosis and related abnormalities.
